::: {#exm-shift-lse}

#### The confident logits again

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
c = z.max()
shifted_lse = (c + torch.log(torch.exp(z - c).sum())).item()
print(shifted_lse, torch.logsumexp(z, dim=0).item())
print(torch.log_softmax(z, dim=0))
```

For the [logits](#def-logits) times 1,000 of @sol-naive-softmax,
shifting by their largest entry gives $\operatorname{LSE} = `r sprintf("%.1f", py$shifted_lse)`$,
the same value `torch.logsumexp` returns,
and `torch.log_softmax` gives finite log probabilities
where the formula gave `nan`.

:::
